report.title: Custom URI links are not clickable
report.body:
### Check before submitting

- [x] I searched existing issues and did not find a duplicate

### Describe the bug

First of all, thanks for the software!

Pasting a URI with a custom scheme (such as `obsidian://` or `slack://`) into a memo does not turn it into a link. 

Adding it using the "link" button makes it appear as a link, but you can't click it. "Open link" is greyed out.

### Steps to reproduce

**WYSIWYG (markdown mode off):**
1. Start editing a memo.
2. Paste a custom URI, such as `obsidian://`, `slack://`, etc.

**Expected:** The URI becomes a clickable link.
**Actual:** It appears as plain text.

**Using the GUI:**
1. Select some text and click the "link" button.
2. Enter the custom URI.

**Expected:** A clickable link is created.
**Actual:** The text appears as a link, but "Open link" is greyed out.

**Workaround:**
Use a service such as [LinkOpen](https://linkopen.app/) to create a `https` URI.

### Memos version

26.11.0

### Additional context

_No response_
